passkey.blocked.mac: On a Mac, a passkey provider has to be turned on first: System Settings › General › AutoFill & Passwords, for example the Passwords app.
passkey.blocked.other_manager: Another password manager may have taken over the passkeys of this browser. Turn its passkey support off for this site, or choose this browser or your system when it asks where to find the passkey.
passkey.blocked.windows: On Windows, Windows Hello has to be set up (Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options). Without it Windows asks for a security key.
passkey.error.method_removed: That passkey is no longer an unlock method of this account. Use your master password.
passkey.error.passkey_bad_answer: The answer of the browser was not what Ferret asked for. The vault was not opened.
passkey.error.passkey_blocked: The browser refused at once, before it asked you anything. The vault was not opened. Check the following, or use your master password.
passkey.error.passkey_cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed or ran out of time. The vault was not opened. You can try again.
passkey.error.passkey_failed: The passkey did not work. The vault was not opened. Use your master password.
passkey.error.passkey_not_verified: The passkey did not check who is using it (a PIN, a fingerprint or a face). A passkey without that check cannot open the vault.
passkey.error.passkey_other_credential: The browser used another passkey than the ones that open this vault. The vault was not opened.
passkey.error.passkey_security: The browser refused to use a passkey for this web address. The vault has to be opened over https with its host name, not with an IP address.
passkey.error.passkey_unlock_failed: The passkey did not open the vault. Try again, or use your master password.
passkey.error.passkey_unsupported: This browser or system cannot use a passkey for this. Use your master password.
passkey.error.prf_failed: The passkey did not open the vault. Try again, or use your master password.
passkey.error.prf_unavailable: A passkey cannot unlock the vault now: this server does not offer it, or no passkey is set up for this account. Use your master password.
passkey.window.checking: Reading which passkeys this account has…
passkey.window.done: The vault is open. This window closes by itself.
passkey.window.help: Your browser or system asks you to prove that it is you, with a fingerprint, a face or a PIN. Your master password still works.
passkey.window.title: Unlock with a passkey
